name: Home Care Caseload (Historical)
description:
This dataset records historical home care caseloads by year and month, spanning 1995 through 2019. Each row represents one month in a given year and includes the number of active cases along with two derived measures: the percentage change in cases from the previous month and the percentage change from the same period a year earlier. The data contains roughly 290 sampled rows across five columns, with a small share of missing values in the case count and change fields.

The data supports tracking how demand for in-home support services has shifted over two and a half decades, including seasonal patterns within years and longer-term growth or decline. It could be used by social service agencies and analysts to monitor caseload trends, compare year-over-year demand, identify periods of rapid change, and inform capacity planning, budgeting, and resource allocation for home care programs.
